newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - DeKalb, Monsanto, Mycogen buys.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - DeKalb, Monsanto, Mycogen buys.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth analyst Bonnie Wittenburg said she reiterated buy ratings on agricultural firms DeKalb Genetics Corp, Monsanto Co and Mycogen Corp and her hold rating on Pioneer Hi-Bred International Inc based on estimates for U.S. corn and soybean plantings.

-- Wittenburg said she expects U.S. corn acreage may be 80 million to 81 million acres, instead of 81 million to 82 million acres expected earlier. Soybeans, which are carrying relatively high prices now versus corn, may draw some acreage away from corn.

-- In a research report, Wittenburg said sales of Bt corn -- which is genetically altered to fight off insects -- are showing mixed results, with several companies saying that the limited supplies will probably sell out. Among the players, she said Mycogen and Novartis are believed to be having better luck than others because they got a head-start on the selling season since they already had U.S. Environmental Protection Agency approvals.
-- Pioneer shares were trading at 68-1/8, DeKalb at 65-1/4 and Mycogen at 26-1/8, all unchanged. Monsanto shares were up one at 37-3/8.
